about: The Minecraft Brewing Stand: a Schedule I Mixing Station variant (same networked station, so co-op sync comes from the game) that looks, sounds and behaves like Minecraft's, built from the player's own Minecraft files.

columns.id: Schedule I item ID registered by the mod
columns.clone_from: Vanilla buildable cloned through S1API (keeps its networked station prefab)
columns.mc_lang_keys: Keys tried in the player's Minecraft en_us.json for the display name
columns.mc_icon: Inventory icon path inside the player's Minecraft client jar
columns.mc_model_base: Block model drawn as the station (models sheet id)
columns.mc_model_bottle_full: Block models for bottle slots 0-2 when a batch is in (models sheet ids)
columns.mc_model_bottle_empty: Block models for bottle slots 0-2 when empty (models sheet ids)
columns.mc_sound_done: Minecraft sound event played when a brew finishes (sounds sheet id)
columns.max_bottles: Units per brew (Minecraft's stand holds 3 bottles)
columns.minutes_per_bottle: In-game minutes per unit (1 in-game minute = 1 real second; 3 bottles ~ Minecraft's 20 s brew)
columns.accepts_roles: Ingredient roles the stand accepts (ingredients sheet roles)
columns.needs_awkward_roles: Roles that need an Awkward batch first (Minecraft: effect ingredients only work on an Awkward Potion)
columns.vanilla_stations_reject_roles: Roles a normal Mixing Station refuses, so Minecraft ingredients are brewed at the stand
columns.shop: Shop group that sells it (shops sheet id)
columns.description: Tooltip text written for the mashup

rows.description: Minecraft's Brewing Stand. Three bottles at a time: Nether Wart first, then the good stuff.
